Initial release of mflux-image-router — fleet-routed local image generation for Apple Silicon.

- Route image generation across your Apple Silicon devices with automatic node selection based on memory, model availability, and CPU load.
- Supports Z-Image-Turbo, Flux Dev, and Flux Schnell models with detailed usage guides for curl, Python, and JavaScript.
- Features queue management, dashboard monitoring, and per-request tagging.
- Integrates with Ollama Herd for LLM inference, speech-to-text, and embeddings on the same fleet.
- Includes clear setup and API instructions, with guardrails against accidental file or model deletions.
